svg.title: From published m⁶A sites to computational PEGG designs
svg.desc: Goal 1 curates published m⁶A site calls, applies an exploratory mean methylation threshold of at least 80 percent, and forms HEK–HeLa intersection and union sets. Goal 2 annotates genomic regions using the hg38 RefSeq GTF on the NCBI GRCh38 assembly, maps CDS sites to same-strand transcripts, checks RNA bases, predicts amino-acid changes, matches nonsynonymous site–transcript pairs to MANE Select, deduplicates site IDs before exclusion, and runs PEGG on the intersection input. The final box explains a later negative-strand coding-effect correction and why PEGG was not rerun.
svg.text: From m⁶A measurements to PE-screening candidates
Curate single-base calls, evaluate coding effects, then nominate computational pegRNAs.
GOAL 1 Curate published single-base m⁶A site calls
1 Published measurements
SAC-seq: HEK293 and HeLa
GLORI: HEK293T
eTAM-seq: HeLa
2 Group means and threshold
Mean over available methods ≥80%
HEK group: 27,623 sites
HeLa group: 11,064 sites
3 Form the HEK–HeLa intersection and union
Combine the two ≥80% group sets.
Intersection: 5,646 sites • Union: 33,041 sites
GOAL 2 Assess coding effects and design candidate pegRNAs
4 Annotate genomic regions
Classify CDS / UTR / other using hg38.ncbiRefSeq.gtf.gz (UCSC).
CDS sites: 2,758 intersection • 13,279 union
5 Map CDS sites to transcripts; check RNA base
Transcript models: hg38.ncbiRefSeq.gtf.gz (UCSC).
Match exact site ID and RNA strand; set aside non-A mappings.
One CDS site may map to several transcripts, producing multiple rows.
6 Predict the amino-acid effect of RNA A→G
Classify each RNA-A edit as synonymous or nonsynonymous.
Sequence: GRCh38.fa, from GCF_000001405.26_GRCh38_genomic.fna.gz.
7 Match nonsynonymous effects to MANE Select v1.5
MANE Select: matched NCBI/Ensembl representative transcript per locus.
Purpose: flag protein-changing edits in representative isoforms (1,571 / 8,507 pairs).
8 Deduplicate site IDs, then exclude flagged sites
Intersection: 5,646 − 1,571 = 4,075 retained sites.
Union: 33,041 − 8,493 = 24,548 retained sites.
One union site contributes 15 of the 8,507 qualifying transcript rows.
9 Run PEGG on the intersection input
4,075 sites entered PEGG; 3,796 sites received at least one guide.
Two runs produced 136,868 default-like / 264,104 custom pegRNA rows.
Genome input: GCF_000001405.26_GRCh38_genomic.fna.gz (NCBI).
Union: 24,546 inputs prepared after two chrM skips; no union-wide design run.
CORRECTION Earlier negative-strand codon-orientation error
Recomputed MANE exclusions: 1,832 / 9,697 sites; 3,814 / 23,344 remain.
PEGG was not rerun; only existing intersection guides were reused.
Current guide subsets: 129,128 default-like / 248,876 custom rows.
Counts are intersection / union unless labelled. A site, a site–transcript effect and a pegRNA are different counting units.
The candidates are computational, not validated screening reagents. MANE-only does not establish protein neutrality in every isoform.
